creator: Nacer Amrouch
body:
• Instant Form Reply: Reactivate immediate SMS response when patient submits a form (was previously active, now disabled or broken). Trigger should fire instantly on form submission, welcoming the patient and setting follow-up expectations.

  • Appointment Confirmation SMS: Build two-stage reminder system: 2-day advance reminder and 2-hour day-of reminder. Both must accept reply logic for confirm (C) or cancel (X), replicating the exact behavior Full Smile had with Flex Dental. Confirmed appointments need to mark the patient record accordingly. Figure out how to sync GHL appointment confirmation status back to Open Dental's color-coded status indicators: Green = confirmed appointment, Yellow = sent (reminder sent, not yet confirmed). This likely requires API integration or webhook between GHL and Open Dental to update appointment status fields in real time.

  • Review Request Automation: Add a trigger to the GHL Opportunity pipeline that sends a review request when Contact reached the Request Review Stage of Pipeline.

  • Lead Call Routing: Inbound calls from Google and LSA lead campaigns should create GHL Opportunities (not just contacts). Ensures proper pipeline tracking and follow-up automation from first touch.

  • What Done Looks L:ike: Instant form-reply fires on every form submission, 2-day and 2-hour appointment reminders send with working C/X reply logic, review requests texted when triggered in Pipeline, Google/LSA calls create Opportunities in GHL, and confirmed appointments in GHL update Open Dental status to Green (Yellow for sent-but-not-confirmed).
